title: Secret Textures
technical_connection: Focus, aperture, zoom, and minimum focusing distance
prompt: Photograph an ordinary surface so closely that it becomes mysterious or difficult to identify.
questions: Where is the most interesting detail?
Which part needs to be sharp?
What happens when light comes from the side?
Would the texture look stronger without its surroundings?
technical_reminder: If the camera cannot focus, the photographer may be too close. Move backward slightly and try again.
Watch for the participant's shadow falling across the subject.

variation.text: Combine two contrasting textures, such as rough and smooth, or make an image your partner cannot identify.

review_prompt: Which photograph makes the texture feel most visible or surprising?
partner_activity: Partners can guess what each other photographed.
